manifest.relayImplementation: MqttRelay full mesh, source-only export, imported messages delivered locally
assumptions: Static topology; no discovery, election, beacons or failover
Separate ingress, routing and delivered topics; no No Local
Profile lookup uses original publishers; forwarding traffic and fanout are outside calibration conditions
TopicPayloadBytes excludes MQTT/network headers; actual model transports complete serialized packets
Warmup is drained before measurement; all model results are exploratory, not native federation fidelity

manifest.loadScheduling: equal per-publisher slots; closed-loop QoS1/2; bounded per-publisher credit, no reassignment of blocked load
assumptions: No TCP proxy overhead, health checks or session migration
One direct receiver per independent backend
CPU/RSS and native proxy resources are not modeled
